overview: Buildings Beo is a property show with a difference: it's not only about the renovation of heritage buildings all around the country, but also about the people and the communities who bring these buildings to life. In this 6-part series, presenter Carrie Crowley takes a closer look at six inspiring projects across Ireland, where derelict architectural legacies are being preserved and transformed into vital community spaces. With over 166,000 vacant buildings in Ireland today, BUILDINGS BEO sheds light on the urgent need for renewal of abandoned spaces. With projects ranging from historical mills to old schoolhouses, each episode follows the journey of a different restoration, showcasing the trials, tribulations and triumphs that come with preserving Ireland's architectural heritage. Some of the remarkable restorations include the transformation of the historic Hope Castle Gate Lodge into a thriving community library in Castleblayney, Co. Monaghan, the revival of a railway building into a digital hub and youth centre in Ballinamore, Co. Leitrim, and the redevelopment of a fire-ravaged cinema into a state-of-the-art local theatre in Cork's market town of Macroom. Audiences will be wowed as each episode culminates in a final reveal, as all the hard work comes together and the building is brought back to life. Throughout the series, Carrie meets with the builders, architects, and communities driving these restoration projects, offering viewers a behind-the-scenes look at the transformation process. Through compelling storytelling and stunning visuals, "Buildings Beo" celebrates Ireland's rich cultural and architectural heritage, demonstrating how it takes a village to make a Building BEO. Produced by New Departures Media.
title: Buildings Beo

overview: At the heart of Y Deis is a unique blend of general knowledge, skill, strategy - and a little bit of luck. Three teams of two go head-to-head across several rounds, building their prize pot through quick thinking and smart play. Only one team makes it to the final, where they face a high-stakes quiz against the clock to claim the Jackpot.
title: Y Deis

overview: At the heart of An Deis is a unique blend of general knowledge, skill, strategy - and a little bit of luck. Three teams of two go head-to-head across several rounds, building their prize pot through quick thinking and smart play. Only one team makes it to the final, where they face a high-stakes quiz against the clock to claim the Jackpot.
title: An Deis

overview: The Entrepreneurs will spotlight 12 of this year's EY Entrepreneur Of The Year™ finalists, offering viewers unique insights into the highs and lows, and risks and rewards of business. Narrated by renowned broadcaster Kathryn Thomas, each 30-minute episode will feature three of this year's finalists, exploring their entrepreneurial journeys, the challenges they've overcome, and the bold thinking that drives their success – embodying the ambition, creativity and confidence that define the island of Ireland's entrepreneurial spirit.
title: The Entrepreneurs

overview: Trackers: The People vs The Banks is a two-part series that goes behind the headlines to tell the real story of Ireland's tracker mortgage scandal through the eyes of those most affected.
title: Trackers: The People vs The Banks

overview: In a fast-paced review of the video viral revolution, Alex Zane presents a countdown of the funniest, rudest and most bizarre video clips to have taken the internet by storm.
title: Rude Tube

overview: Soviet Storm is a new and epic television history of the Second World War's Eastern Front. Giving an unprecedented Russian perspective on the war's most decisive and bloody theater.
title: Soviet Storm: WWII in the East

overview: 22 years ago, Savva got in touch with criminals and was charged with murder. After being released, he decides to give up his criminal past and start a quiet life with his beloved. But someone is clearly against this development of events: Savva is being dragged into a showdown, blackmailed and deprived of hope for a bright future. Blinded by revenge, he decides to investigate his own past and find those who ruined his life. What Savva doesn't know is that the truth will turn out to be much more complicated than he expected.
title: Приговор

overview: A look ahead to upcoming 2026 UEFA European Qualifiers.
title: European Qualifiers Preview Show

overview: The story of dinosaurs equipped with state-of-the-art suits and their pilots fighting against alien mechanical dinosaur corps.
title: Armored Saurus

overview: MsLabelled is a witty, vlog-style comedy series set in the fast-paced, high-pressure world of fashion. The series features Ella, a young fashionista who tries to find her own voice in the industry by launching an upstart fashion blog, after landing a job at a magazine overseen by editor-at-large Jeanne Beker.
title: MsLabelled
Noona, You Are a Woman to Me

overview: The story is a heartwarming comedy about "sparkling prince" private tutor Kishi Naito and the hot-headed delinquent Takasugi Toru. Toru's mother, worried about her son's constant fighting and rock-bottom test scores, hires Kishi as his tutor. Though Toru is bewildered by Kishi's gentle and sweet teaching style, he soon finds himself drawn into Kishi's pace — setting the stage for a dramatic transformation in his life.
title: Kateikyoushi no Kishi Naito Desu

overview: V Morgan is Dead is a fantasy series by Smokebomb Entertainment about Violet "V" Morgan's death, and subsequent employment on the mysterious "Sixth Floor" as a fixer. Episodes premiere on the KindaTV Youtube Channel on Thursdays at 5pm. There are currently 18 episodes in the first season, and several bonus videos, such as "Life on the Sixth Floor" videos and cast interviews. The official social media accounts post transmedia in the form of Benson's files and reports, and the official website also has a blog used by the characters.
title: V Morgan is Dead

overview: Kano Akihito, a reserved man who moved from the technical department to sales, struggles to fit in and feels isolated at work. His relationship with his talented colleague Ogami Seiji becomes strained due to an incident, leaving him torn between admiration and inferiority. One night, Akihito discovers a mysterious mirror at a shrine and he wished that "I want to become someone who can laugh together with Ogami as an equal." The mirror transports him to a parallel world where he's more confident and accepted. In this new reality, even Ogami looks at him differently. As Akihito experiences this ideal version of his life, he begins to confront his true emotions and learns what truly matters in the real world. This is a heartfelt story about self-discovery and love between two people trying to reconnect.
title: Love Begins in the World of If

overview: When an escaped convict is cornered by law enforcement at a truck stop, he takes hostages in an effort to bargain for his freedom. But the standoff soon escalates into an unmanageable social experiment with his captives — and an emotional poker match with a veteran FBI Crisis Negotiator trained in "tactical empathy."
title: Rabbit, Rabbit

overview: 24 celebrities live together like elves on an abandoned pig farm. But among them is a mischievous elf who is out to sabotage the game.
title: Nissene i skjul

overview: The Front Line follows two half-brothers who couldn't be more different: Malcolm, a serious, rule-following police officer, and Sheldon, a laid-back Rastafarian who trusts his own path over authority. Sharing a home, their culture clashes, sibling squabbles and everyday mishaps fuel the comedy.
title: The Front Line

overview: Due to a miscarriage of justice, Rong Zelan ventures alone into the inner circles of power, determined to carve her own path in the male-dominated Imperial Medical Bureau. Though scorned by the male doctors, she rises against all odds with her great medical skills. By healing the Crown Prince, saving the Empress Dowager, and quelling a deadly plague, she achieves monumental feats that make her the first female official of this dynasty. She now leads the men who once looked down on her, crafting an inspiring legend of a woman earning her place in the court.
title: Rise of Her Lady Physician

overview: The Arrangement is a Cinderella story for modern times, with a dramatic and complicated Hollywood twist. The drama follows Megan Morrison, a beautiful young actress who auditions for the female lead in a summer blockbuster playing opposite Kyle West, the hottest actor of the moment. After an amazing audition segues into a dream-like first date, Megan's Cinderella story takes a turn to the bizarre when she is presented with a contract that details an entire relationship with Kyle. Megan must weigh her options and the benefits and consequences to her career and her life overall... and decide whether or not she will accept "The Arrangement".
title: The Arrangement

overview: The Next Step's Kenzie salvages what is left of a broken cheer team, desperate to prove that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.
title: The Next Step: Cheer

overview: The Netherlands is and has always been a leader in the drug industry. Our country has long tolerated hashish, cultivated Dutch-grown weed, helped heroin addicts, traded cocaine, and produced ecstasy. Ajouad El Meloudi delves into this history.
title: Holland Drugsland

overview: Aylín, a teenager from a working-class neighborhood, discovers her supernatural abilities; when she eats dirt, she has visions that help her search for missing people. Alongside her brother and friends, she embarks on a journey to control this new power. As her abilities grow stronger, she becomes a heroine who stands up against the violence and injustice affecting her neighborhood.
title: Cometierra

overview: The game is started by three pairs of participants. After the second round, the team with the lowest score is eliminated, and the finalist team is determined based on the results of the third round. The basic prize earned by the winners consists of the sum of points for correct answers. But the final amount of winnings depends on fortune. By rolling a cube with coefficients, players can increase the cash prize by 5, 10, 50 or 100 times.
title: Усатые факты

overview: Reality series about the close-knit community of St. Willebrord. This once poor village is now thriving. Willebrord residents love big cars, expensive designer clothes, perfect hair, and shiny roof tiles. Parents spoil their children generously, and adapting is the norm. This reality series follows prominent residents at home and at work—in the clothing store, butcher shop, and hair salon. A proud village where traditions and humor collide, and no one ever wants to leave.
title: St. Willebrord: Het mirakel van Brabant

overview: At the Roelvinkjes, everything revolves around family. Dries, Dave, Donny, Honoria, Luciënne, and Marijn offer a glimpse into their turbulent lives. Follow the highs and lows of this Amsterdam family.
title: De Roelvinkjes

overview: Harris and Marina, a young couple with financial problems, unexpectedly inherit an old mansion in Kifissia. Moving there, they discover that the house is inhabited by nine eccentric ghosts of different eras. When Marina, after a hit in the head, acquires the ability to see and talk to them, begins an unpredictable, comedic coexistence ensues. Greek adaptation of the British BBC series "Ghosts".
title: Ta fantasmata

overview: Mohamed and Shrouq's lives are turned upside down due to a rare, unusual pregnancy.
title: Natural Disaster

overview: Southern Bastards follows a tenacious military vet into Craw County, Alabama, in search of her estranged father. What she finds is a murderous hornet's nest of organized crime run by the winningest high school football coach in the South.
title: Southern Bastards

overview: Inspired by true events, Marwa, a high-profile TV host, crosses paths with a powerful lawyer live on air. A single spark pulls her into a world where personal feelings collide with public pressure. As the spotlight intensifies and power games escalate, she must decide how far she'll go - and whom she can trust - without losing her voice.
title: Roses & Chocolate

overview: Renowned adventurer Bogdan Bulychev is assembling a team to embark on a unique journey in domestically produced all-terrain vehicles across the land borders of the Russian Federation. The first continental expedition begins in Murmansk and will travel through numerous regions of the country, from the Arctic to Kaliningrad. The intrepid travelers will experience changing climates, enjoy diverse and picturesque nature, visit wild, impenetrable places, and immerse themselves in incredible adventures that will require endurance and cooperation. The captivating educational documentary project "Russia 360" was created by the Russian Society "Knowledge" for a wide audience of all ages.
title: Россия 360

overview: Huang Yu, a strong and spirited girl working as a servant at the Xiafeng Pavilion, accidentally stumbles upon a secret operation by the Jinyiwei investigating a stolen silver case—and becomes the prime suspect of their cold and stoic commander, Lu Zhan. Though she eventually clears her name, her unusual abilities draw Lu Zhan's attention, and she is coerced into joining the Northern Jinfu Si as a junior constable. All Huang Yu wants is to earn enough money to retire peacefully, but her cold-faced boss keeps exploiting her at every turn. With her rare gift for forensic insight, she helps solve a series of mysterious cases, only to uncover the truth of her own past: her family was destroyed years ago by the powerful minister Jiang Ning. As memories resurface, so does her burning desire for revenge. Beneath Lu Zhan's iron-blooded exterior lies hidden tenderness, and he, Huang Yu, and the Minister of Justice Shen Pan become entangled in a triangle of rivalry, trust, and buried emotions. Together, they navigate deadly conspiracies in the imperial court. Amid blades and shadows, Huang Yu and Lu Zhan find love, expose the crimes of the treacherous Zhao Yutang, and clear her family's name. Behind every case lies a web of power and deceit, of love and hatred intertwined. From a streetwise nobody to a fearless game-changer, Huang Yu rises to stand beside Lu Zhan—guarding justice and writing a story of mutual redemption in turbulent times.
title: A Mission of the Heart

overview: "The Sopranos" creator David Chase is working on a thriller series at HBO titled "Project: MKUltra."
title: Project: MKUltra

overview: Girl power and killer harmonies. Stars from All Saints, Mis-Teeq and more take a trip through the highs and lows of 90s pop and beyond - from adoration to the flip side of fame.
title: Girlbands Forever

overview: A brutal death. Eight interrogations. One culprit. Two detectives investigate a homicide in a mansion where each guest hides a dangerous secret. A terminally ill man is violently murdered during a family reunion and it begs a question: who would kill someone who was already going to die?
title: Cenas de Um Crime

overview: Lee Su-geun, Eun Ji-won and Kyuhyun embark on a dream journey to Kenya — only to find that every meal and adventure is locked behind a wacky challenge.
title: Three Idiots in Kenya

overview: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.
title: Heweliusz

overview: Torn between two loves, Alicia secretly marries both a famous writer and a former priest. How long can she juggle love, lies and her double life?
title: Simplemente Alicia

overview: After 10 years together, Seventeen look back at where they've been to uncover where they'll go next.
title: Seventeen: Our Chapter

overview: Bake Master Battle is a high-stakes bake-off with three teams of elite bakers competing and showcasing their confectionery mastery in a series of thrilling and festive challenges anchored to seasonal themes.
title: Bake Master Battle

overview: Tired of hearing about scammers operating with impunity and destroying lives? Scammed: Getting Even is dedicated to turning the tables on digital criminals. Ashton Bingham and Art Kulik have assembled an elite dream team of tech experts known as the 'Revengers' that traces these criminal organizations back to their source, exposing their fraudulent schemes in real-time. They confront the faces behind the screens, often thousands of miles away, and engineer retaliation.
title: Scammed: Getting Even

overview: Two-part documentary, which provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office hit "Avatar: The Way of Water" and a first look at the upcoming "Avatar: Fire and Ash," features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.
title: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films

overview: The ultimate hunt for Norway's luckiest! 90 children from all over the country compete in fun and spectacular tasks that are based solely on luck.
title: Flaks, ferdig, gå!

overview: In 1985, Henki Hauge Karlsen is fired from his bartending job when he chooses to tell his employer that he has tested positive for HIV. He refuses to accept this, goes to court and quickly becomes the face of the "homsepesten" (Norwegian slang/slur from the 80s referring to gay men living with HIV AIDS).
title: Henki

overview: The gentle and honest high school student, Ninako Kinoshita, had never experienced the feeling of love and spent her days unaware of it. One day, on the train ride home, she meets her classmate Ren Ichinose. Gradually, she finds herself drawn to the hidden kindness within him. Though a painful feeling like something piercing her chest begins to stir, her feelings for Ren grow stronger day by day. Eventually realizing that this feeling is "love," Ninako gathers her courage and confesses her feelings to Ren, but...
title: Strobe Edge

overview: Having no clue about what traveling around the world entails, Juanpa Zurita convinces Disney+ that he can do it with just a small plane and legendary pilot Matt Guthmiller. Traveling to eight destinations across four continents, with eight celebrity guests to make sure he wouldn't fail alone, and a small budget he managed to get from Disney, it was inevitable this would turn into a complete disaster.
title: La Peor Vuelta al Mundo

overview: 35 years after the death of Estefanía Gutiérrez Lázaro, the 17-year-old who died under strange circumstances at her family home in Vallecas (Madrid), HBO Max reopens the 'Vallecas File' to investigate what really happened based on the testimonies of her family and the people who know the case best.
title: Expediente Vallecas

overview: "Stars on a Drip" is an anti-alcohol social reality show in which celebrities who have failed to overcome their addictions on their own are sent to celebrity rehab. They will take a break from touring, filming, and their normal lives to undergo a full course of rehabilitation under the guidance of an experienced addiction specialist and his team.
title: Звезды под капельницей

overview: A heartfelt story about the deep bond and love between two teenage boys — a tale that is tender, pure, and deeply emotional.
title: The Two Of Them

overview: Good Behavior follows Letty Raines, a thief and con artist who is always one bad decision from implosion. Fresh out of prison, she's attempting to stay afloat. But when she overhears a hit man being hired to kill a man's wife, she sets out to derail the job, sending her on a wild collision course with the killer. Fresh out of prison, Letty tries to stay afloat and reunite with her 10-year-old son, who is currently being raised by her mother Estelle. Letty has to show up for mandatory check-ins with her parole officer Christian, whose motives for helping her are questionable. Chaos returns to Letty's life when she overhears a hitman being hired to kill a man's wife, and sets out to derail the job. She soon finds herself dangerously entangled with the killer.
title: Good Behavior

overview: Every year, a 20-page Scavenger Hunt list plunges the University of Chicago into fun, sleepless chaos.
title: Scav

overview: Achi, a smart female police captain, is assigned to protect Patty, the daughter of a powerful politician recently targeted in an attack. To stay safe, Patty secretly swaps places with her bodyguard Alice in order to keep the mission under wraps. As Achi works to keep Patty safe, she starts to feel something more than just duty. Love begins to grow—slowly, quietly—in the middle of danger. But strange things begin to happen, and Patty and Alice are both hiding something.
title: Mission: Love Or Lies

overview: Talented chef Jónas, falsely imprisoned, tries to regain his family's trust. Shunned by society, he accepts illicit funds to open a restaurant, leading him to money laundering. This jeopardizes his parole, life, and loved ones.
title: Reykjavík Fusion

overview: Yang You accidentally crosses into a parallel universe on the day of a lunar eclipse, becoming a soul entity. He can only materialize within 200 meters of Chen Shi, and to survive, he has no choice but to stay close to Chen Shi. During their time together, Yang You discovers that despite Chen Shi's tough exterior, he is unusually caring toward him. Gradually, Yang You falls for Chen Shi and boldly confesses his feelings. However, just as he decides to give up on returning to his original world, he realizes that Chen Shi knows too much about him, even things he never mentioned. His reporter instincts lead him to suspect he is trapped in a carefully orchestrated scheme.
title: PlutoCharon

overview: Set in a future where companies have seemingly unlimited power, Incorporated centers around Ben Larson, a young executive who risks everything to infiltrate the all-controlling corporate world and save the woman he loves. In the process, he will take on the entire system -- with deadly consequences. Ben is married to Laura, a successful plastic surgeon who's also the daughter of Ben's boss. While Ben and Laura make their home in the lush, manicured Green Zone of the well-to-do, Theo dwells in the dangerous, poverty-stricken Red Zone, and may provide a surprising connection to Ben's past. In a high-stakes world where the ethical boundaries we know have been completely redrawn, how far is Ben willing to go -- and what happens if he fails?
title: Incorporated

overview: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but solely to safeguard their families and neighborhood.
title: Heroes Next Door

overview: Rainbow Rumble is ABS-CBN's latest trivia game show hosted by Luis Manzano, where five players race to reach the peak of a color pyramid in a bid to advance to the jackpot round for a chance to win one million pesos.
title: Rainbow Rumble

overview: A glimpse into the lives of gorillas and their relationships with humans in an experiment that has never been attempted before.
title: Gorilla School

overview: Incredible tales of wonder and woe are told as the staff at China's Wolong National Nature Reserve struggle daily to preserve one of the most popular yet endangered species on Earth -- giant pandas.
title: Pandamonium

overview: Eva and her sisters live humbly in Lisbon, unaware that their lives are about to take an unexpected turn. When Gaspar, a wealthy businessman based in Angola, suddenly dies, he leaves his entire fortune to the three young women, who overnight become the owners of a great fortune and an entire estate in Angola. However, not everything will be a bed of roses: they will have to confront Talu, a young Angolan engineer who was excluded from Gaspar's inheritance in favor of Eva. And despite being in opposite sides, neither Talu nor Eva will be able to resist the strong attraction they feel for each other. Among the breathtaking landscapes of Angola and the modern business world of Portugal, the young lovers will find themselves at the center of a web of antagonistic interests, in the dispute over Gaspar's inheritance.
title: A Fazenda

overview: Cyberbullying and hacker attacks change the lives of the main characters shortly before their high school graduation. Corvin, Nola, Patricia, and Simon are actually looking forward to their future beyond school, but then the "shadow side" appears and changes everything. The website reveals the teenagers' most intimate secrets, and the more people click on it, the more explosive material comes to light. Nothing remains taboo: chat histories, screenshots, nude photos, and videos are suddenly accessible to the public. There's only one chance to stop the leaks: the person affected must cooperate with the "shadow side" – and simultaneously betray their closest friends. Does this all have something to do with the recent death of classmate Linus?
title: Schattenseite

overview: Inspired by the iconic Play for Today format, each production will champion new voices and focus on bringing low-income talent into the spotlight behind the scenes in writing, directing and production roles.
title: Play for Today

overview: Every year, five families meet at an idyllic summer destination. But this summer is anything but idyllic. One year after Linnea disappeared, the families return. Linnea is still not found – and when her cell phone turns up, lies and guilt are forced to the surface. Noen Lyver(en: Someone is Lying) is a suspense series about friendship, love – and trust. Because who can you really trust when family secrets are revealed and loyalties are broken? And what do you do when the safest people in life may be the ones you should fear the most?
title: Noen Lyver

overview: Salmon farming has become a successful industry. But beneath the surface lies a sea of suffering, conflict, and illegal exports. Do we really have control?
title: Brennpunkt: Lakselandet

overview: Fredrik Skavlan takes the temperature on his neighboring country, Sweden. An entertaining and engaging show with topical interviews and debates, guests from very different worlds – and a presenter without voting rights.
title: Skavlan & Sverige

overview: A rare and human insight into the corridors of power. Award-winning portrait of the former NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg, the limited docuseries extends beyond the "Facing War"-documentary with more insights and never-before-seen scenes.
title: Stoltenberg i møte med krigen

overview: The story follows experienced detective captain Su Lingyu and audio-visual department head Jiang Cheng, who team up to solve a series of complex cases and grow together through the process. The investigation begins when a brutally tortured male body is found at a steel factory — the only clue being a mysterious recording seemingly staged by the victim himself. Fifty catties of gold have gone missing, and a kidnapping victim has vanished without a trace. As the police dig deeper, they uncover the victim's own web of crimes, including school bullying, fraud, sexual bribery, and loan sharking. Meanwhile, a long-buried family massacre resurfaces. Things escalate when Su's ex-girlfriend witnesses her former lover bleeding from all seven orifices and on the brink of death. A "black widow" commits a string of murders by poison and passion. At Xingsheng Hospital, a corpse disappears from the morgue — only for the former deputy director's body to later be found inside. As Su Lingyu and Jiang Cheng pursue the truth, the investigation exposes a vast criminal network and an unexpected mastermind behind it all. Through their unwavering teamwork and determination, they not only bring the perpetrators to justice but also uncover the truth behind the mysterious death of Jiang Cheng's parents, ultimately dismantling the entire crime syndicate.
title: Sonic Judgement

overview: The Hillside Strangler explores the infamous murders that gripped Los Angeles in the late 1970s and the exhaustive investigation that followed. In the late 1970s, Los Angeles was the serial murder capital of the world. The Freeway Killers. The Toolbox Killers. The Dating Game Killer. The Skid Row Slasher. But none terrorized this city of millions more than the Hillside Strangler, a phantom who struck without warning, abducting, raping, and murdering a dozen women and girls and leaving their bodies displayed on the hillsides like grim trophies. These crimes sparked the largest manhunt in LA's blood-soaked history, led by a relentless homicide detective named Frank Salerno. His dogged pursuit led to the strangler's capture and the revelation that these vicious acts were perpetrated by two men, Kenneth Bianchi and his cousin Angelo Buono.
title: The Hillside Strangler

overview: Hidden between the lines of the history books is the story of Mary Stuart, the young woman the world would come to know as Mary, Queen of Scots. Queen of Scotland since she was six days old, the teenage Mary is already a headstrong monarch - beautiful, passionate, and poised at the very beginning of her tumultuous rise to power. Arriving in France with four close friends as her ladies-in-waiting, Mary has been sent to secure Scotland's strategic alliance by formalizing her arranged engagement to the French king's dashing son, Prince Francis. But the match isn't signed and sealed, it depends more on politics, religion and secret agendas than affairs of the heart. With danger and sexual intrigue around every dark castle corner, Mary rallies her ladies-in-waiting and steels herself, ready to rule the new land and balance the demands of her country and her heart.
title: Reign

overview: Tattoos After Dark is a U.S. reality show following after-hours events at two Los Angeles tattoo parlours and the antics of their staff and customers.
title: Tattoos After Dark

overview: The Alienist, based on the Anthony Award-winning New York Times bestseller by Caleb Carr, is a fast-paced and atmospheric psychological thriller set in the fascinating and gritty world of Gilded Age New York City. After a series of haunting and gruesome murders, psychiatrist Dr. Laszlo Kreizler, newspaper reporter John Moore and police commissioner Theodore Roosevelt come together employing emerging disciplines of psychology and early crime investigation techniques to track down one of New York City's first serial killers.
title: The Alienist

overview: London's big day out. All the atmosphere of the traditional parade that always brings fun and colour to the city's streets.
title: The Lady Mayor's Show

overview: Heist: Robbing the Bank of England documents the 1990 Bank of England bond heist which saw a theft of £ 292 million. Hosted my Marcel Theroux, this series will travel across the globe to tell this incredible true story which spanned several continents over three decades, leaving many unanswered questions…until now.
title: Heist: Robbing the Bank of England
